listing.name: Super Mario 64 Render96
listing.summary: Super Mario 64 Render96 using an existing installation that you manage.

steps.title: Set up Render96 before adding it
steps.instruction: Follow the Render96 project’s instructions to prepare a permitted Windows installation using your own matching Super Mario 64 original. Finish extraction or compilation, then start and close the game successfully before adding it. Portcove does not build Render96 or import the original game. Optional model and texture packs have separate requirements; you do not need them to add the game to Portcove.

steps.title: Choose the game program
steps.instruction: Choose the program from your working build, rather than its compiler, build script or a launcher that starts a separate process. The inspected standard Windows US build normally produces build/us_pc/sm64.us.exe; region and renderer options can change its name. Keep its resources and companion files together. Use the same start folder and launch options as your working installation. Review and save the launch details, then choose Play separately.

steps.title: Keep your existing save and settings folders
steps.instruction: Separate program folders can share saves. The inspected SDL2 build uses the sm64ex preferences folder by default. When the newer save is absent, it can copy an older sm64pc save and settings into that folder. Keep the actual sm64ex and sm64pc folders, sm64_save_file.bin, sm64config.txt and any custom data. Keep your existing --savepath, --configfile and --gamedir launch options only where your build supports them; ! in a supported save path means the executable folder. Do not move or change your save folder just to add the game to Portcove.

steps.title: Handle updates and backups yourself
steps.instruction: You or the Render96 project’s tools handle updates, optional packs, resources and recovery. Back up the complete working installation, originals, resources, dynos/packs, mods, saves, settings and any unknown files before changing it. Portcove watches the selected game process and can remove its saved launch details. It won’t update, back up, restore, switch to older versions, move or delete this external copy. Older copies installed by Portcove keep their existing setup and update behavior.

warnings: Use only originals, prepared copies and optional packs that you are permitted to use. Adding a program does not verify that the whole package came from its publisher or grant content rights.
These instructions describe the inspected build. Check the actual locations and behavior of your working copy; other build options and platforms may differ.

presentation.manual_preparation: Build Render96 with the project’s instructions and your own original, then select the resulting game program. You handle optional packs, updates, saves and settings. Portcove remembers how to launch it. Older copies installed by Portcove keep their existing setup and update behavior.
